title: 192. Design Circular Queue

examples.explanation: Capacity 3. EnQueue 1, 2, 3 succeed; enQueue 4 fails (full). Rear is 3, isFull is true (1), deQueue succeeds, enQueue 4 succeeds, Rear is 4.
Capacity 2. EnQueue 7 succeeds, Rear and Front are 7, deQueue succeeds, then isEmpty is true (1).
Capacity 1 starts empty so Front/Rear are -1 and isEmpty is true (1). EnQueue 5 succeeds, then isFull is true (1).

hints: Keep a fixed-size array with head and count pointers; indices wrap with modulo k.
enQueue fails when full, deQueue fails when empty; Front/Rear return -1 when empty and booleans are encoded as 1/0.
